name: team_P2_rot
lines: ⊢ team_P2 m i ((finRotate (2 * m + 3)) i) = team_w2 i
hc : ↑((finRotate (2 * m + 3)) i) = if ↑i = 2 * m + 2 then 0 else ↑i + 1
⊢ 1 / 2 - team_v2 i + team_v2 ((finRotate (2 * m + 3)) i) - team_tau m = team_w2 i
⊢ ((1 / 2 - (1 - 2 * team_tau m) * if ↑i = 0 then 0 else if ↑i = 1 then 1 / 4 else if ↑i % 2 = 0 then 1 / 2 else 0) +
else if ↑((finRotate (2 * m + 3)) i) % 2 = 0 then 1 / 2 else 0) -
if ↑i ≤ 1 then 3 / 4 - 3 / 2 * team_tau m else if ↑i % 2 = 0 then 0 else 1 - 2 * team_tau m
(1 - 2 * team_tau m) * if ↑j = 0 then 0 else if ↑j = 1 then 1 / 4 else if ↑j % 2 = 0 then 1 / 2 else 0) -
⊢ 1 / 2 - (1 - 2 * team_tau m) * 0 + (1 - 2 * team_tau m) * 0 - team_tau m = 3 / 4 - 3 / 2 * team_tau m
⊢ 1 / 2 - (1 - 2 * team_tau m) * 0 + (1 - 2 * team_tau m) * 0 - team_tau m = 0
⊢ 1 / 2 - (1 - 2 * team_tau m) * 0 + (1 - 2 * team_tau m) * 0 - team_tau m = 1 - 2 * team_tau m
⊢ 1 / 2 - (1 - 2 * team_tau m) * 0 + (1 - 2 * team_tau m) * (1 / 4) - team_tau m = 3 / 4 - 3 / 2 * team_tau m
⊢ 1 / 2 - (1 - 2 * team_tau m) * 0 + (1 - 2 * team_tau m) * (1 / 4) - team_tau m = 0
⊢ 1 / 2 - (1 - 2 * team_tau m) * 0 + (1 - 2 * team_tau m) * (1 / 4) - team_tau m = 1 - 2 * team_tau m

steps.tactic: simp only [team_P2, if_neg hne, if_pos hn]
generalize finRotate (2 * m + 3) i = j at hc
